bio: Sadiq is an Information Management Technology student at the Centre for Distance Learning, Modibbo Adama University, Yola. His experience as a radio presenter and businessman gives him practical communication and organizational skills that support the team's project work.

Musa Aliyu is a dedicated 400-level student of Information Management Technology at Modibbo Adama University, Yola. He is passionate about information technology, data management, and digital solutions. With a strong academic background and practical exposure, Musa is committed to using technology to solve real-world problems.

Hadiza Aminu is a 400-level Information Management Technology student in the distance learning programme at Modibbo Adama University, Yola. She has skills in web development and is applying her academic knowledge to practical technology projects. She expects to complete her BSc in Information Management Technology in 2026.

Ahmed Sahabo Ubandoma is a 400-level Information Management Technology student at the Centre for Distance Learning, Modibbo Adama University, Yola. He is a civil servant and works with YP Art and Printing, where he engages in art, graphic design, and printing services. He is passionate about technology, information management, and continuous learning, and applies these interests to his personal and professional development.
Sarenso Obidah Nebari is from Toungo and is studying Information Management Technology at Modibbo Adama University, Yola.
Rukaiya Mohammed was born in Yola South, Adamawa State, and lives in Demsawo, Yola North Local Government Area. She is studying Information Management Technology at Modibbo Adama University, Yola.
